text: {"label":"Radical Behaviorism as Philosophy","definition":"Work explaining, defending, and teaching radical behaviorism as the philosophy of science underlying behavior analysis, including its treatment of private events, ontology, values, verbal behavior, and historical development.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers specifically on radical behaviorism's tenets, unlike broader surveys of behaviorism's varieties and methodological behaviorism, behavioral accounts of creativity and complex behavior, or evolutionary theories of behavior."}
